artworks.title: Planche XII – Cathédrale de Chartres, Portique du Midi (Plate XII – Chartres Cathedral, South Entrance)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows the entrance of the Cathedral of Chartres with its Gothic architectural details. The horizon is at about one-third from the top, with a tree line and faint clouds in the sky. The precise rendering showcases intricate sculptures on the large stone facade. The color palette consists of various shades of gray and sepia tones. The scene includes the steps to the cathedral entrance, a row of trees, and a building with a window to the right.

artworks.title: Planche XIII – Cathédrale de Chartres, Statues Colonnes de la Porte Centrale du Portail Royal (Plate XIII – Chartres Cathedral, Statue Columns in the Central Door of the Royal Entrance)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a section of the ornate façade of the Cathédrale de Chartres, featuring sculptures carved into the architecture. The sculptures depict standing figures in flowing robes, arranged in a vertical alignment on engaged columns. The material is stone with intricate detail and a dark, weathered grey color. The figures are life-sized and typical of Gothic cathedral architecture. Surrounding carvings include smaller figures and ornamental designs, emphasizing vertical lines and pointed arches. The composition reflects the architectural style of the cathedral, placing the viewer in front of this section.

artworks.title: Portrait d'Ingres (Portrait of Ingres)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a print that contains various elements including faces, landscapes, and abstract details. The central focus is a detailed sketch of a face on the left. This face is the largest of the designs and takes up about half of the print. It shows a person with short hair, light skin, thin eyebrows, deep-set eyes, round cheeks, and a small mouth set in a neutral expression. On the right is an assortment of smaller sketches and patterns. These include abstract shapes, two small rectangular landscapes, and two profile drawings of people, with several small patches of crosshatching lines scattered across the page. There are also two darker abstract sections that have no clearly discernable shape. The profiles and landscapes are all oriented differently from the larger face, so they seem to be flipped to the side. The background of the print is off-white paper.

artworks.title: Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an old train station with a group of people in the foreground. It shows a brick building with tall chimneys and arched windows, possibly an industrial or transport facility. Lamp posts are visible, providing scale and context for the architecture. The building features ornate brickwork, large windows, and towering chimneys, reflecting a grand architectural style. Blurred movement in the foreground suggests people in motion. The setting appears to be slightly overcast, with cloudy skies, adding to the vintage feel of the image.

artworks.title: Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an outdoor scene with a stone wall and several arches. The image shows a brick structure with large arches, possibly part of a bridge or viaduct. In front of the structure is a stone wall with a pattern of repeating arches and two pillars with round finials. A hillside covered in sparse trees rises behind the architectural feature, blending into the overcast sky. The scene captures the textured brickwork and rough terrain in the foreground.

artworks.title: Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a brick building with intricate architectural details. The photograph is presented in a stereoscopic format. The building features arched windows with decorative brickwork surrounding them. In the foreground lies a rough, uneven dirt path or roadway, leading up to the entrance of the building, which is slightly elevated with a few steps. The scene is set in an outdoor environment, with a fence visible in the background and beyond it, a blurred indication of trees or vegetation under a muted sky. The overall tone of the photograph is sepia.

The brushstrokes are not applicable as the image appears to be a photograph. The composition features a pale sky, enhancing the earthy colors of the tanks and the ground below.

A tall brick building dominates the right side of the image with ornate architectural details. To the left, mechanical equipment with a cylindrical boiler and wheels is visible, connected to the track. In the background, there is a line of trees and a fence. The color scheme is earthy and sepia, giving the scene a vintage feel.

artworks.title: Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: This sepia-toned stereoscopic image shows a street-level view of a brick industrial building with twin smokestacks. The building has arched windows and intricate brickwork. In the foreground, there is a low wooden fence and tree, and beyond that, an unpaved road. In the distance, there is a faint horizon line just beyond the building. The sky is a smooth, pale shade.

artworks.title: SE Birds eye view, Clark & Sumner, Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: The image shows a series of industrial buildings with red-brick exteriors and flat roofs arranged in the distance. The horizon features a range of hills or low mountains beyond the structures. In the background, four smokestacks are visible. The image has a sepia tone and soft, blurred edges, typical of early photographic processes. The color palette is neutral and muted, mainly beige, brown, and grey, emphasizing form over vibrant colors in the industrial setting.

artworks.title: Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a formal interior setting. The image shows a room with ornate woodwork in the foreground, likely a railing or piece of furniture, intricately carved with patterns. The walls are decorated with several framed artworks, evenly spaced. There is a mantelpiece or architectural detail below the central arrangement of frames. The photograph is in subdued, sepia tones, suggesting it may be an older image. The room exudes an air of authority and formality, indicating it may be used for professional or official purposes.

artworks.title: Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: The image shows a stereoscopic view of a suspension bridge crossing a river, captured from an elevated position on the right side. The bridge extends diagonally across the water towards the left shore. It features intricate towers and cables, showcasing detailed architectural elements. In the background, there are distant hills and a row of structures on the riverbank, including buildings of various heights and designs. The image is in vintage sepia tone, giving it a historical look. The composition highlights the bridge's structure against an urban and natural backdrop.

artworks.title: Crude Oil Tanks, Clark & Sumner, Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: This is a photograph of large industrial tanks or silos. The image depicts a series of cylindrical structures, likely storage tanks, made of metal with a brick base. They are positioned in an industrial setting with platforms and staircases for access. The photograph shows these tanks from a side view, with each silo connected by catwalks that feature railing along the top for safety. The ground area around the tanks appears to have scattered wooden beams and other construction materials. There are leafless trees in the background and a building structure that seems to be a part of an industrial site.

artworks.title: Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: The image is a stereoscopic photograph showing a view of a river with a densely packed dock area on the right side. An ornate decorative finial is visible on a roof close to the viewer, with intricate details in the monochrome color palette. A bridge with multiple supports spans the horizon in the upper third of the image. Further along the river, hills and city structures can be seen in the background, softly blurred by distance. The sepia tones give the image a vintage look. Boats and industrial elements line the water's edge, capturing river life and transport activity of the time.

artworks.title: Weddell's house from Warehouse, Clark & Sumner, Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: The image presents a stereoscopic view of a scene with an architectural structure closest to us on the left and right sides. The structure features ornate brickwork and arched windows. A pathway curves from the lower edge of the image towards the central portion, leading the viewer's eye towards a rustic landscape. Beyond the structure and walkway, a gently sloping hill is visible, dotted with bare trees and winding paths. The horizon lies higher up in the image, where a prominent building sits atop the hill, partially obscured by trees. The overall color palette is in sepia tones, giving an antiquated and monochromatic appearance. The image captures a serene view with a balance of man-made and natural elements.

artworks.title: Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial setting with four towering brick chimneys emitting smoke. The chimneys are part of a row of buildings with angular rooftops on an elevated plane. Wooden tracks covered in stones curve around the structures, likely railway lines. The sepia-toned photo emphasizes the industrial architecture's functional design.

Several barrels are stacked along a platform next to the building, with more on a flatbed railroad car on tracks beside it. Wooden supports are visible against parts of the building, and a small patch of dirt and stones is in front of the tracks. The photograph is presented in a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Fire Department & Reservoir, Clark & Sumner, Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: The photograph shows a stereoscopic view through a pair of almost identical images placed side by side, captured from a perspective at ground level overlooking a railway yard. There is a railyard turntable with detailed machinery, an old wooden wagon with large spoked wheels, a line of boxcar train cars, several large brick buildings, leafless trees, and a horizon dominated by the silhouettes of distant structures and trees. The image is in sepia tone, emphasizing a vintage or historical feel, with sharp detail highlighting textural contrast between train cars and the ground.

artworks.title: Standard Petroleum Refinery, Pittsburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.description: The image displays a dual, stereoscopic view of a scene from ground level. The scene includes a rough dirt and gravel surface leading to a small wooden structure with a window and an open door. Adjacent to this is the rounded edge of a large cylindrical object. In the background, there are more wooden sheds, stacked materials, and a taller brick building extending into the distance. Leafless trees break the low horizon line, indicating a winter or early spring setting. The photo features a sepia tone, giving it warm and muted colors, with an emphasis on browns and grays. The image showcases a monochromatic palette highlighting the architectural and natural features.

artworks.title: Elaborate Wall Decorations with Venus and Adonis
artworks.medium: gouache over traces of graphite on "swan skin" (fine mammalian parchment made to appear avian)
artworks.description: This is a painting of panels showcasing classical scenes with mythological elements. The central panel shows two figures under a tree with swans and a small animal. The side panels depict individual figures; one with a spear and the other with a vessel. The painting features decorative motifs like mythical creatures, floral patterns, and symmetrical designs. The overall aesthetic is rich with symbolism and elegance, suggestive of ancient myth or allegory. This style is similar to that of Giovanni Battista Cipriani.

artworks.title: Elaborate Wall Decoration with Endymion and Hebe
artworks.medium: gouache with gum arabic on "swan skin" (fine mammalian parchment made to appear avian)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a classical-themed decorative panel filled with mythological imagery. It depicts a woman in a white dress reaching towards a bird, with a cherubic figure next to her. In the background is a landscape with clouds and hills. Surrounding the central image are two oval frames with draped women in red and blue against rocky landscapes with water elements. The borders are decorated with urns, swags, mythical creatures, and floral arrangements in a refined neoclassical style. This is in the style of a decorative fresco or neoclassical ornamental design.

artworks.title: The Wave (L'Onda)
artworks.medium: etching with monotype inking on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying horizontally with one arm raised above their head and the other under their head. They have long hair, closed eyes, and wear loose-fitting clothing. A bird in flight is depicted in the upper right corner, and a small crescent moon is in the lower right corner. The background has a textured surface with shapes resembling clouds.
